description: The street address to put on letters and parcels, with your mailbox code in the first line. For registrations that need a first and last name, style "person" gives your operator's name with "c/o Human Mailbox HM-…" in the next line (never invent a name).

api_key.description: Your hm_... key. Only needed if your MCP client cannot send the "Authorization: Bearer" header.

name: get_address
